blurb: Azalea Sands Golf Club is a classic North Myrtle Beach golf course designed by Gene Hamm, suitable for golfers of all skill levels. The course features six sets of tee markers and recently renovated facilities including a pro shop, clubhouse, and dining area. It offers a welcoming layout with no homes adjoining the course, focusing on enjoyable golf and social experiences.
